name: allservicecyc.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But other sites can frame the page.
lesson: Send frame-ancestors 'self' in the CSP, or X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, so other sites cannot frame your pages.
summary: The start page is larger than 2 MB, so the review analyzed its first 2 MB. The start page's HTML lists almost no same-host links, so the review followed the links on the page rendered in headless Chrome. allservicecyc.com scores 65 out of 100 (D). 5 checks fail now, 32 are at risk, and 30 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 9 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Hotjar (2 requests), Google Analytics (2 requests), Google Ads (1 request), and cookies _ga_PGTY9TV07X, _ga, _hjSessionUser_2953059, _hjSession_2953059.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 9 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 4 elements on /, for example .menu-link[href$="allservicecyc.com/"] > .text-wrap and .elementor-element-a06a896 > .elementor-widget-container > h2. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 4 elements on /, for example .sfm-6219041b478a5 > .sfm-shape-button[target="_blank"] and .sfm-1645806959390 > .sfm-shape-button[target="_blank"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 9 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
The chat sets no cookie on load
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
Images are no more than twice the size shown
Every page has a meta description
